ctaHeading: Build Your Perfect Shed in Altona
aboutText: Sheds Melbourne has been serving Altona and surrounding areas for over a decade, providing top-quality shed solutions. We understand the diverse needs of our clients, from steel garages to farm buildings. Our complete range includes barns, stables, carports, and commercial buildings, all designed for durability and installed to your specifications. We aim to deliver superior quality at competitive prices, ensuring your shed meets your exact requirements.
servicesText: We specialise in a wide variety of shed types, from residential garages to large-scale farm and commercial buildings. All our products are available in kit form or fully installed, tailored to suit your personal requirements and budget.

services.title: Steel Garages
services.desc: Our steel garages are built to last, providing secure storage for vehicles, tools, and equipment. They can be fully customised to fit your specific space requirements.

services.title: Farm Buildings
services.desc: We construct sturdy farm buildings designed for agricultural use, including storage sheds, hay barns, and livestock shelters. Each structure is tailored to the unique needs of farmers.

services.title: Barns & Stables
services.desc: From classic barns to modern stables, we offer a range of options for livestock and equestrian properties. Our buildings are constructed with quality materials for longevity.

services.title: Carports & Verandas
services.desc: Protect your vehicles and create shaded outdoor areas with our carports and verandas. Easy to install and available in various styles to match your home.

services.title: Rural Buildings
services.desc: Versatile rural buildings for workshops, machinery storage, and general farm use. We ensure each building is functional and built to withstand the elements.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial Buildings
services.desc: Large-scale commercial and industrial buildings for businesses requiring ample storage or workspace. Our solutions are designed for durability and can be installed quickly.

contactSubheading: We're here to help with your shed project
